candidates.change_summary: Change the return value from ERC721TokenReceiver.onERC721Received.selector to a different constant (0xdeadbeef) to make the function return a different bytes4 while keeping signature and body structure.
Make the function return the bitwise NOT of the original selector, changing the returned bytes4 value.
Return bytes4(0) instead of the selector, causing a different return value while still completing.
Replace assignment to baseToken with assigning zero address instead of the provided _baseToken, causing baseToken to differ after initialize.
Replace assignment to baseToken with assigning msg.sender instead of the provided _baseToken, changing stored baseToken after initialize.
Replace assignment to baseToken with assigning nft (swap), so baseToken is set to the provided NFT address after initialize.
Replace assignment to nft so initialize sets nft to msg.sender instead of the provided _nft parameter.
Assigns a different value to changeFee by swapping assignment to set changeFee to _changeFee + 1 instead of _changeFee.
Replace the assignment to feeRate with assignment that adds 1 to the provided _feeRate (off-by-one), so feeRate becomes _feeRate + 1.
Replace the assignment to feeRate with zeroing it, so feeRate becomes 0 regardless of _feeRate.
Insert an extra check that caps _feeRate to 1000 when higher, then assign feeRate = _feeRate (possibly changed), changing resulting feeRate when input exceeds 1000.
Remove the line that sets initialized = true so initialize does not mark the contract as initialized.
Set initialized = true only after emitting the Initialize event (move statement after emit), changing the point in time when initialized becomes true.

Change the guard so initialize checks feeRate first and sets initialized = true only after setting feeRate to 0 if too large (forces different revert behavior), here we replace the fee rate check with an assignment that clamps the fee and still sets initialized = true.
Flip assignment of payRoyalties in initialize: set payRoyalties = !_payRoyalties instead of payRoyalties = _payRoyalties.
Delay setting payRoyalties until after initialized flag is set: assign payRoyalties = _payRoyalties after initialized = true.
Prevent payRoyalties from ever being true by forcing assignment to false regardless of input.
